caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped ceramic platter with a detailed landscape scene in its center and a decorative border. The central scene shows a river or lake with several small boats or sailboats on the water, mountains in the background, and trees and foliage framing the scene on the left and right sides. In the foreground, there are two small human figures standing on the shore, with more faint figures and structures visible in the midground. The border of the platter is decorated with large, intricately drawn seashells and marine motifs, including various types of shellfish and underwater plants, arranged symmetrically around the rim. The entire image is rendered in shades of grey, giving it the appearance of a black and white or monochrome illustration. The objects in the drawing include trees, hills, boats, water, people, and an array of sea shells. The composition presents the central landscape within the confines of the platter, with the ornate border creating a frame around the scene.
title: Platter - "Lake George"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
